oracle-l5r-1323: Chikushudo's Trickery (Open, destroy this Spell, bow its Shugenja, one or two performing unbowed Nonhuman Spirit Personalities and another player's unbowed Personality: "Create a battlefield. Negate all movement to it. Assign the target to attack there; he will not be destroyed during the battle's Combat Segment. Assign the performing Spirits to defend there. Fight a battle there."). A battle outside an Attack Phase at a battlefield that belongs to no province: the same unbuilt structure as Shinobi Assault (oracle-l5r-9927) and The Perfect Moment. Every battle in the engine is keyed by the Defender's province index (MatchState.CurrentBattleProvince / UnresolvedBattlefields, Army(), EffectiveProvinceStrength, the province-destruction step of ResolveBattle, Reconnaissance on ProvinceState) and is reached only through the Attack Phase's SelectBattle and its phase sequence (Battle -> BattleSelection -> Dynasty). It needs (1) a created province-less battlefield that Army()/AtBattle/the resolution step accept (no province to destroy, no Honor from a province), (2) a battle fought from and returning to the Action Phase (with the first-opportunity, Combat Segment and Resolution Segment machinery re-entered), (3) direct assignment of chosen units to the attacking and defending sides with no Maneuvers Segment, (4) a battlefield-scoped 'negate all movement to it' and (5) a Combat-Segment-only 'will not be destroyed' shield on one card. Best built once, jointly with Shinobi Assault and The Perfect Moment (the shared 'create a battle' primitive); the rest of the card (the Nonhuman Spirit performers slot, the unbowed target of another player's, the Spell destroyed and the Shugenja bowed as costs) uses existing primitives.
